    • floatHistoRange

      default ChannelDisplaySettings.Builder floatHistoRange(double min, double max)
      Sets the histogram axis range for floating point images, as pixel values.

      Only meaningful for float images, whose axis is a real value range rather than a bit depth. Pass Double.NaN for both to clear it.

      The default implementation ignores the values, so that builders written before the float axis existed keep compiling; they simply carry no axis range.

      Parameters:
      min - low end of the axis
      max - high end of the axis
      Returns:
      this builder

    • floatHistoRangePinned

      default ChannelDisplaySettings.Builder floatHistoRangePinned(boolean pinned)
      Marks the float histogram axis as chosen by the user.

      When set, the axis is left exactly as given instead of being widened to take in each newly displayed image.

      Parameters:
      pinned - true to stop the axis adapting to the data
      Returns:
      this builder

    • intensityScaling

      ChannelDisplaySettings.Builder intensityScaling(ChannelIntensityRanges ranges)
      Sets the intensity scaling (min/max) for all components of this channel in one call.

      This is a convenience alternative to calling component(int, ComponentDisplaySettings) once per component. Only min and max are transferred; any gamma values already set on existing component settings are preserved.

      Parameters:
      ranges - per-component intensity ranges for this channel
      Returns:
      this builder
